text: At 86 minutes, Ironvale Athletic takes control with a swift attack. On the right flank of Redmond Rovers' half, Ilias Thorne receives the ball near the penalty area at the far end. He shoots quickly, sending the ball into the net to equalise the score at 3-3. This goal follows two earlier Ironvale shots from Jonah Lindqvist, one blocked and one saved, showing Ironvale’s effective counter-attacking play against Redmond’s high press [#1500] [#1529] [#1537].
